grammar.title: To seem, appear with 显得
grammar.explanation: 显得 (xiǎnde) means "to appear, seem, look" — it's followed by an adjective describing how someone or something comes across, based on how they act or look.

grammar.title: Taking the initiative with 主动
grammar.explanation: 主动 (zhǔdòng) means "to take the initiative, proactively" — it describes doing something without being asked or forced. It goes right before the verb.

sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǔdòng bāng wǒ ná dōngxi.
sentences.en: He proactively helped me carry things.
She took the initiative to talk to me.
We should take the initiative to learn.
